title: Split transcript scroll keyboard tests from oversized SessionPaneView suite
outcome: SessionPaneView.scroll.test.ts is now over 7,000 lines and the reviewed diff grows its body-keyboard and selection-ownership coverage. Extract that coherent family into a sibling test module with the repository split header. While moving it, guard history-demand cleanup so an earlier assertion failure cannot pass undefined and obscure the primary error.
acceptance: Body-keyboard and selection-ownership tests live in a focused sibling module, retain all assertions, use unwind-safe guarded cleanup, and the full Vitest suite remains green.
